create_video_transform: create a video transform pipeline for training or validation with subsampling, normalization, and cropping
apply_uniform_temporal_subsample: apply uniform temporal subsampling to select equispaced frames from a video tensor
apply_mixup_cutmix: apply mixup or cutmix augmentation to a batch of video tensors and labels
apply_randaug_augmix: apply randaugment or augmix data augmentation to a video tensor for robustness training
apply_short_side_scale_and_crop: apply short side scaling and uniform cropping to video tensors with optional bounding box support
